metadata.name: atrm
metadata.displayName: atrm - Remove at jobs from queue
metadata.description: Remove pending jobs from the at queue

installation.note: atrm is part of the at package

overview.summary: atrm removes one or more pending at jobs from the queue. You specify job numbers (from atq). Only the job owner or root can remove a job.
when_to_use: Remove a job by number (from atq)
Clear mistaken or obsolete at jobs

syntax.description: JOB is the job number shown by atq. Multiple job numbers can be given.

related_commands.description: List jobs to get numbers for atrm
Schedule jobs; atrm removes them (at -d JOB is equivalent)
